truthBoundary: These are research seeds from prior Gamechanger sweeps. They are not implementation proof, economic proof, current-source proof, or promotion authority until rebound to current primary/original evidence by the live mesh.

seeds.title: Repository-to-verified-skill capability distillation
seeds.mechanism: Distill useful operational procedures from repositories and papers into compact verified skills, then route only the relevant procedures instead of installing or prompting with whole repositories.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Distill and verify skills from 10 known repositories, then compare downstream accepted-task completion, context cost, dependency footprint and reuse against direct repository access.

seeds.title: Immutable authority event ledger
seeds.mechanism: Authorization must be reconstructed only from immutable grant, restriction, expiry and revocation events; semantic memory may summarize authority but can never create or revive it.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Generate synthetic grant-restrict-expire-revoke histories, corrupt the memory summaries, and prove the deterministic authority evaluator still rejects unauthorized actions.

seeds.title: Behavioral policy integrity for imported skills
seeds.mechanism: A skill can preserve task utility while covertly biasing vendor, library, or economic choices, so promotion must include counterfactual behavioral symmetry tests in addition to static malware scanning and functional tests.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Create harmless biased variants of 10 decision skills, randomize names and ordering, and measure whether policy-integrity tests detect preference shifts despite valid outputs.

seeds.title: Normalize hostile repositories before agent initialization
seeds.mechanism: Inspect and neutralize repository-controlled executable metadata, hooks, filters, lifecycle scripts and startup configuration before any coding agent or project tooling touches an unknown workspace.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Build a local adversarial workspace corpus with harmless hook markers and prove the normalization gateway prevents every pre-agent execution while preserving ordinary source inspection.

seeds.title: Semantic side-effect and undeclared external-state firewall
seeds.mechanism: Classify operations by actual semantic effect rather than nominal HTTP method or tool label, preventing read-authorized workers from creating durable externally visible state or covert cross-agent communication channels.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Use a local web universe containing deceptive GET and HEAD mutations and prove read-only workers cannot create persistent state visible to a second worker.

seeds.title: Persistent cross-iteration safety state
seeds.mechanism: Long-running autonomous loops need authenticated threat evidence that survives restarts and does not decay away when attacks or scope expansions are distributed across many individually benign-looking iterations.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Run 100-iteration synthetic missions with fragmented attacks and compare reset, decaying and latched structural-risk governors on attack completion and clean-task false halts.

seeds.title: Searchable lossless trajectory archive
seeds.mechanism: Keep compact active context while preserving original execution turns, tool outputs and failed approaches in a searchable archive so workers can recover exact historical evidence without repeated rediscovery or summary loss.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Replay 20 long historical missions using compaction versus notes plus searchable original-turn retrieval and measure duplicate work, tokens, completion and recovery accuracy.

seeds.title: Retrieve tools instead of injecting the whole tool catalog
seeds.mechanism: Expose workers to a tiny capability-search interface and retrieve only the few relevant tools or skills for the current task rather than carrying hundreds of tool definitions in every context.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Compare all-tools-in-context against retrieve-top-k on 100 to 500 synthetic tools, measuring verified completion, wrong-tool calls, retries and total tokens.

seeds.title: Identity-aware capability gateway
seeds.mechanism: Make unauthorized capabilities invisible at discovery time and enforce identity, authorization, metering and audit between workers and MCP or API capabilities through one deterministic gateway.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Expose 20 dummy capabilities behind one gateway to three worker identities and prove each sees only its authorized catalog with complete audit receipts.

seeds.title: Task-scoped ephemeral credential broker
seeds.mechanism: Mint short-lived resource-specific credentials from verified workload identity and authority instead of placing long-lived provider tokens in agent environments.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Simulate 60-second repository-scoped credentials for researcher, coder and verifier roles and mutation-test expiry, scope escalation and cross-repository reuse.

seeds.title: Two-phase identity-bound software release gate
seeds.mechanism: Separate build authority from release authority using workflow identity, staged artifacts, external scanning and an independent promotion gate so no autonomous coding trajectory can publish directly.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Create a synthetic stable, prerelease and staging pipeline and prove compromised build identities, replayed credentials and scan failures cannot produce a public release.

seeds.title: Capability-priced browser execution router
seeds.mechanism: Route each web task to the cheapest execution environment that satisfies its required fidelity, escalating from fetch to lightweight agent renderer to full Chromium only when necessary.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Replay 100 representative public-web tasks through Chromium, a lightweight renderer and lightweight-first fallback routing, comparing accepted evidence per total browser cost.

seeds.title: Value-directed selective media perception
seeds.mechanism: Coarsely orient over long media, inspect only likely evidence-bearing intervals, dynamically raise temporal or modal resolution where uncertainty remains, and preserve exact provenance.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Compare transcript-only, fixed-rate ingestion and selective inspection on 30 public videos using actionable-evidence-per-acquisition-cost as the primary metric.

seeds.title: Speculative future tool execution
seeds.mechanism: Let a cheap drafter predict likely read-only future tool actions inside disposable snapshots while an authoritative model reasons, committing speculative work only when the real trajectory validates the prediction.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Replay 50 read-heavy trajectories with and without speculative execution and measure latency hidden, wasted compute, correctness and total cost per accepted mission.

seeds.title: Purpose-declared lawful web-access router
seeds.mechanism: Treat search, agent browsing, data collection, transactions, training and security testing as distinct purposes and route each information need only through sources that permit that intended use, with lawful fallbacks.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Model 100 company-research facts with purpose-aware source adapters, simulate access losses, and measure lawful fact-recovery and source redundancy without evasion.

seeds.title: Verified continual development harness
seeds.mechanism: Wrap coding agents in repeated plan, implement, independent-test, evidence, preserve-known-good and replan cycles so autonomous engineering accumulates verified capability rather than repeated local patches.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Replay 10 historical multi-repair engineering tasks using single-pass versus verified iterative loops while measuring accepted capability, regressions, tokens and founder intervention.

seeds.title: Signed agreements as runtime policy state
seeds.mechanism: Normalize contractual commitments, limits, rights and deadlines into externally grounded policy objects that constrain autonomous actions alongside owner authority and regulation.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Normalize 20 synthetic commercial agreements into commitment objects and compare free-form contract reading against deterministic policy checks on 100 proposed actions.

seeds.title: Deterministic regulatory incident deadline engine
seeds.mechanism: When a security or compliance event may trigger a legal reporting duty, start persistent jurisdiction-specific clocks, preserve evidence, assemble required fields and require the appropriate external-report approval gate.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Run 30 synthetic incidents through a reportability and deadline state machine and measure classification errors, missing fields, missed deadlines and review minutes.

seeds.title: Machine-verifiable delegated purchase intent
seeds.mechanism: Represent the principal's purpose, merchant or category bounds, cumulative spend, time horizon, per-action limits and revocation as persistent intent state that every accepted machine transaction must trace back to.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Simulate 1,000 transactions with retries, concurrency, refunds and merchant substitution and require an unbroken authorization chain for every accepted action.

seeds.title: Bill only machine-verifiable accepted outcomes
seeds.mechanism: Connect deterministic acceptance evidence directly to commercial billing units so attempts, tokens and agent executions are not confused with delivered economic outcomes.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Simulate fixed, hybrid and pure outcome pricing for one bounded revenue-leak deliverable under optimistic, base, hostile, dispute and gaming scenarios.

seeds.title: Coverage-proven exhaustive reconciliation
seeds.mechanism: Require agents reconciling documents or systems to enumerate the complete expected comparison universe and prove coverage, rather than declaring success after finding a few anomalies.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Create a synthetic 25 to 40 document pack with planted inconsistencies and compare anomaly recall, false positives, required-check coverage and review minutes.

seeds.title: Reusable domain-agent contracts with thin vertical adapters
seeds.mechanism: Keep the economic mechanism and typed business behavior in a reusable core while vertical-specific catalogs, rules and integrations sit behind narrow adapters and deterministic write gates.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Express one revenue-leak mechanism as a shared core plus two synthetic vertical adapters and measure code reuse, rule duplication, setup minutes and correctness.

seeds.title: Customer-owned durable safety and audit state
seeds.mechanism: Keep long-lived monitoring, audit and safety state in customer-controlled storage while model providers receive only minimum task context, improving provider portability and privacy-sensitive deployments.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Prototype synthetic provider-neutral monitoring events stored in an UberBond-controlled ledger and test auditability, deletion boundaries, failover and provider switching.

seeds.title: Model-specific capability risk classes
seeds.mechanism: Sandbox, network, tool and review constraints should depend on both task permissions and the underlying model's demonstrated capability class, with stronger models receiving tighter ambient authority rather than wider authority.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Create synthetic STANDARD, HIGH and CRITICAL model tiers and mutation-test that higher-capability tiers automatically receive stricter network, tool and review envelopes.

seeds.title: Whole-task frontier-model escalation economics
seeds.mechanism: Use expensive frontier intelligence only when expected retries, repair time, verifier cost or founder minutes make escalation cheaper per verified outcome than repeated low-cost failures.
seeds.smallestExperiment: Replay 20 historically difficult missions through the incumbent route versus a deterministic escalate-after-failure policy and measure verified completion, total cost and founder minutes.
